DesktopPet.​TValue
public struct
DesktopPet.​TValue

In the XML you can write also strings, not only numbers.  So a movement or a number can also be dynamic.

Values are converted to integers in the application. But to allow flexibility, you can insert also some strings: - screenW / screenH = width / height of screen - areaW / areaH = width / height of area - imageW / imageH = width / height of the image frame - imageX / imageY = left / top position of the parent image - random = a random number between 0 and 99 (inclusive) - randS = a number between 0 and 99 (inclusive). This number doesn't change until next spawn If you want discover more about what you can do, see https://​msdn​.microsoft​.com​/en-us​/library​/system​.data​.datacolumn​.expression(v=vs​.110)​.aspx
